children.innerHTML: Six rooms behind the dunes at Vorupør. Bread in the morning, a sauna at four, one long beach. Nothing to do, on purpose.
“We came for a weekend and left different people. Also, the bread.”
Two nights minimum on weekends. The sea insists.
REPLIES BY A PERSON, USUALLY METTE
